author_source: project/Industrial Gas & Cryogenic Equipment/02_EquiTips GASLAB Industrial Fixed Gas Detection Explained（国内版）/src.py

points.K2: 有毒、可燃、缺氧三类危害

points.K6: 实验室、冷库、充装间都需要
points.S2: 窒息性气体：氧含量报警与通风
points.S4: 有人倒下，不要贸然进去救
points.S5: 探测器要定期校准维护

shots.scene: 欣欣站在气瓶间门口，墙上装着白色检测报警器和橙色报警灯，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a gas cylinder room with a white wall-mounted gas detector and an orange beacon light, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲固定式气体检测报警。

shots.scene: 鼻子图标打叉、探测器图标、报警灯图标、出口图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a nose crossed out, a gas detector, a flashing alarm beacon, and an exit door. No people.
shots.narration: 闻不到的危险，要靠仪器和行动。

shots.scene: 阿杰走进放液氮罐和气瓶的小房间，墙上报警灯在闪
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks into a small room with liquid nitrogen dewars and gas cylinders while an orange beacon flashes on the wall.
shots.narration: 阿杰取样时，墙上的报警灯闪了起来。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头站着，身边是看不见的气体曲线图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, unsure, with a faint invisible gas wave icon around him.
shots.narration: 他心想：什么也没闻到，应该没事吧？

shots.scene: 小研在门外招手让阿杰出来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands outside the door and urgently waves for the young male student to come out.
shots.narration: 小研喊：报警响了，先出来再说！

shots.section_title: 危险气体的最大风险：暴露和窒息
shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白白板前，旁边是一个人倒地的警示图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard next to a warning icon of a person collapsing.
shots.narration: 危险气体最大的风险，是暴露和窒息。
overlay: 危险气体的最大风险：暴露和窒息

shots.section_title: 有毒、可燃、缺氧三类危害
shots.scene: 骷髅、火焰、氧气下降三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three warning icons: a skull for toxic gas, a flame for flammable gas, and an O2 symbol with a down arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 气体可能有毒、可燃，或让氧气变少。
overlay: 有毒、可燃、缺氧三类危害

shots.section_title: 有毒、可燃、缺氧三类危害
shots.scene: 看不见的气体从气瓶阀口慢慢扩散到房间
shots.prompt_en: Faint transparent gas slowly spreads from a cylinder valve into a closed room. No people.
shots.narration: 很多气体无色无味，泄漏了也察觉不到。

shots.section_title: 有毒、可燃、缺氧三类危害
shots.scene: 人、房间、仪器三个图标上方都有警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a person, a room and an instrument, each with a yellow warning triangle above. No people.
shots.narration: 伤人，也会损坏设施和设备。

shots.scene: 墙上的白色检测报警器，屏幕上是平稳的曲线图标
shots.prompt_en: A white fixed gas detector on the wall, its blank screen showing a calm wave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 固定式探测器二十四小时不停监测。

shots.scene: 浓度曲线上升，在红线之前就亮起报警
shots.prompt_en: A rising concentration line approaches a red danger line, and an alarm bell lights up before it reaches the line. No people.
shots.narration: 浓度还没到危险值，就先报警。

shots.section_title: 声光报警，联动排风和远传
shots.scene: 橙色报警灯旋转闪烁，喇叭图标发出声波
shots.prompt_en: An orange beacon light flashes and rotates next to a horn icon sending sound waves. No people.
shots.narration: 报警时又响又闪，提醒所有人。
overlay: 声光报警，联动排风和远传

shots.section_title: 声光报警，联动排风和远传
shots.scene: 报警器连线到排风扇，排风扇开始转动
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector connected by a line to an exhaust fan, which starts spinning and pulls air out. No people.
shots.narration: 还能联动排风，把气体排出去。

shots.section_title: 声光报警，联动排风和远传
shots.scene: 报警器连线到值班室，保卫处值班员看到屏幕上的报警图标
shots.prompt_en: A line from the detector runs to a duty room where the security officer sees an alarm icon on a blank monitor.
shots.narration: 信号可以传到值班室和应急人员。

shots.section_title: 声光报警，联动排风和远传
shots.scene: 探测器、控制器、报警灯、风机连成一个圈
shots.prompt_en: A circle diagram linking a detector, a controller box, an alarm beacon and an exhaust fan. No people.
shots.narration: 探测、报警、排风，组成一个系统。

shots.scene: 一排不同颜色外壳的探测器图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of gas detector icons with different colored housings, each with a blank tag. No people.
shots.narration: 探测器种类很多，各测各的气体。

shots.scene: 气瓶清单和探测器一一连线
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist of gas cylinders with lines matching each cylinder icon to a detector icon. No people.
shots.narration: 房间里用什么气，就装测什么的探头。

shots.scene: 测氢气的探头装在高处，测二氧化碳的装在低处
shots.prompt_en: A room diagram: one detector near the ceiling with an up arrow for light gas, another near the floor with a down arrow for heavy gas. No people.
shots.narration: 轻气体往上走，重气体往下沉。

shots.section_title: 实验室、冷库、充装间都需要
shots.scene: 实验室、冷库、气瓶充装间三个场景图标
shots.prompt_en: Three scene icons: a laboratory, a cold storage room and a cylinder filling station. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室、冷库、气瓶间都可能需要。
overlay: 实验室、冷库、充装间都需要

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白检查表查看报警器
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank inspection checklist and looks at a wall-mounted gas detector.
shots.narration: 报警系统的设置，要符合相关标准。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标保护着人，旁边是打勾的检查单
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon protecting a person pictogram next to a checklist with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 既保护人员，也经得起安全检查。

shots.scene: 带空白合格标签的探测器，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector with a blank certificate label and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 选用质量可靠、证明齐全的产品。

shots.scene: 欣欣双手比出叉号，又竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot makes an X with both arms, then gives a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 气体安全不是可选项，而是必需。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本空白法规手册
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank law booklet with a gas cylinder icon on the cover.
shots.narration: 国内要按国家法规和本校制度来做。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白屏幕前讲解，屏幕上是检测报警器图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains in front of a blank screen showing a gas detector icon.
shots.narration: 检测报警怎么设，以现行标准为准。

shots.section_title: 窒息性气体：氧含量报警与通风
shots.scene: 液氮罐和干冰箱放在小房间里，蒸气向地面扩散
shots.prompt_en: A liquid nitrogen dewar and a dry ice box in a small room, cold vapor spreading along the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 液氮、干冰会把房间里的氧气挤走。
overlay: 窒息性气体：氧含量报警与通风

shots.section_title: 窒息性气体：氧含量报警与通风
shots.scene: 二氧化碳气瓶旁，气体沉积在地面低处
shots.prompt_en: Carbon dioxide cylinders in a corner, heavy gas pooling near the floor as a pale layer. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳比空气重，会积在低处。

shots.section_title: 窒息性气体：氧含量报警与通风
shots.scene: 墙上的氧含量报警器和排风口
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen level alarm unit on the wall next to an exhaust vent and a running fan. No people.
shots.narration: 这类房间要装氧含量报警，保持通风。

shots.section_title: 窒息性气体：氧含量报警与通风
shots.scene: 关着门窗、堆满液氮罐的小房间图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tiny closed room crowded with dewars and no ventilation, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要在密闭小房间存放大量液氮。

shots.scene: 阿杰快步走出房门，到走廊上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student quickly walks out of the room into the corridor as the beacon flashes behind him.
shots.narration: 报警一响，立即撤离，不要进去查看。

shots.scene: 电灯开关和火焰图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A light switch icon and a flame icon, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃气体报警，不开关电器，不动明火。

shots.scene: 小研关上房门，在门上挂空白警示牌
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the room door and hangs a blank warning sign on it.
shots.narration: 关门隔离，在门口提醒别人别进。

shots.scene: 小研打电话向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls the older man on the phone from the corridor.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人和学校主管部门。

shots.scene: 老李戴好防护，在门外看着便携检测仪
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears protective gear and checks a portable gas detector at the doorway.
shots.narration: 由专业人员检测确认后，再处理。

shots.section_title: 有人倒下，不要贸然进去救
shots.scene: 房间里一个人倒地的图标，门外的人伸手要冲进去，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person collapsed inside a room and another person rushing in through the door, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有人倒在里面，不能冲进去救。
overlay: 有人倒下，不要贸然进去救

shots.section_title: 有人倒下，不要贸然进去救
shots.scene: 电话图标旁有火焰和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a fire icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 立即拨打119和120求援。

shots.section_title: 有人倒下，不要贸然进去救
shots.scene: 排风扇开启，专业救援人员戴呼吸器的图标
shots.prompt_en: An exhaust fan running and an icon of a rescuer wearing a breathing apparatus. No people.
shots.narration: 通风，等有呼吸防护的人员施救。

shots.section_title: 探测器要定期校准维护
shots.scene: 老李用标定气瓶给探测器做校准
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer calibrates a wall-mounted gas detector using a small calibration gas cylinder and a hood.
shots.narration: 探测器要按说明书定期校准。
overlay: 探测器要定期校准维护

shots.section_title: 探测器要定期校准维护
shots.scene: 被纸板遮住、拔了电源的探测器图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gas detector covered with cardboard and its power plug pulled out, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能遮挡、断电，过期失效要更换。

shots.section_title: 探测器要定期校准维护
shots.scene: 老李在空白记录本上签字
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer signs a blank maintenance logbook next to the detector.
shots.narration: 校准和检查都要做好记录。

shots.scene: 气瓶用链条固定，管路接头上有检漏泡泡
shots.prompt_en: Gas cylinders secured with chains, a leak check solution bubbling test on a fitting joint. No people.
shots.narration: 报警是最后一道防线，源头更重要。

shots.scene: 不同颜色的气瓶并排，旁边有国家标准图标
shots.prompt_en: Several gas cylinders of different body colors stand in a rack beside a blank standard booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶固定，颜色标志清楚，按需存放。

shots.scene: 扳手拧带压接头的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wrench on a pressurized gas fitting with a blank gauge, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 压力管路不得带压拆卸。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现骷髅、火焰、氧气下降三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a skull, a flame and an O2 symbol with a down arrow.
shots.narration: 有毒、可燃、缺氧，都要靠检测发现。

shots.scene: 探测器、报警灯、排风扇打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a detector, an alarm beacon and an exhaust fan, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 按气体选探头，声光报警联动排风。

shots.scene: 出口、电话、校准工具三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an exit door, a telephone and a calibration kit. No people.
shots.narration: 报警就撤离报告，探头定期校准。

shots.scene: 欣欣在走廊里向镜头挥手，背后报警器绿灯常亮
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in a corridor, a gas detector behind showing a steady green light.
shots.narration: 看不见的气体，交给检测和规程，下次见！
